official_contract_rules.description: Adaptive remeshing cannot operate on an orphan-mesh-only model.
The remeshed model must contain native geometry and an initial mesh.
The geometry-backed part created by Part2DGeomFrom2DMesh must be instantiated in rootAssembly.
The orphan-mesh instance must not remain the active remeshing target.
The remeshing rule must address actual geometry faces or cells.
For deterministic behavior, use an explicit Region built from geometry-backed instance faces rather than region=MODEL.
The geometry-backed instance should preserve the original instance name when possible so ODB instance correspondence is preserved.
rootAssembly.regenerate() must occur after the geometry-backed instance and region are created.
A separate AdaptivityProcess must not be added for the single manual Model.adaptiveRemesh(odb) route.
Use exactly one remesh route: Model.adaptiveRemesh(odb).
No fallback remeshing API is permitted.
